item.title: 'I remain capable': Sen. Michelle Kidani asserts her ability to serve amid health rumors
item.description: Vice President of the Hawaiʻi State Senate Michelle N. Kidani reaffirmed her ability to serve after reports that she would retire early for health reasons.

item.title: UH showcases $734M in awards to State Legislature for Research Day
item.description: On Feb. 3, the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa brought research out of the lab and into the Hawaiʻi State Capitol. Students, faculty and staff shared work that tackles health, environment and resilience challenges across Hawaiʻi and the Pacific region.

item.title: Power of plants: Patients improve health with a plant-based diet
item.description: Waimānalo Health Center patients who completed a plant-based nutrition program celebrated improving their health through a healthy diet.

item.title: Sweet Buttercup is looking for her Bubbles and Blossom
item.description: Meet Buttercup! Buttercup is a 1-year-old, 7-pound Domestic Shorthair mix cat who was brought into the Hawaiian Humane Society's care in mid-November after found wandering around a Wahiawa neighborhood.

item.title: 'It starts at 1 a.m.': Feral chickens spark push for legislative fix
item.description: State lawmakers are trying to rein in one of the most annoying public nuisances - feral chickens.

item.title: 'They're using it as a way to skirt gambling laws in Hawaii': Lawmakers look to shut down predictive market websites
item.description: "Predictive market" websites allow bets on sports, but also non-traditional wagers. Some Hawaii lawmakers say that's got to stop.

item.title: Counting 1-10 in Hawaiian helps to understand days of the week
item.description: In the ahupuaʻa of Kalihi, which lies in the moku of Kona here on Oʻahu, stands a roadway that brings our attention to counting ma ka ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi.

item.title: Bus routes expansions could lead to 24 hour availability for airports
item.description: Three current bus routes which go to Makaha, Ewa Beach, and Central Oahu would bring riders to the airport during times the W line and Skyline stop operating.
